title: Energy - 123 school
heading: Energy
intro: All the data you need is in the question. Round to the correct number of digits.

questions.question: Which type of energy does a moving bicycle have?
In which type of energy is the energy stored in petrol?
Which of these energy sources is a fossil fuel?
Which of these energy sources is renewable (sustainable)?
Which energy conversion takes place in a solar cell?
Which energy conversion takes place in a bicycle dynamo?
Which energy conversion takes place in an electric motor?
What does the law of conservation of energy state?

answers.b: Extra energy is created in every conversion
answers.c: Energy is not lost but is converted into another form
answers.d: Energy can be created out of nothing

questions.question: Which formula goes with heating a substance?
You heat 2.0 kg of water from 15 °C to 65 °C. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.18 × 10<sup>3</sup> J/(kg·K). How much energy is needed?
You heat 0.50 kg of iron by 20 K. The specific heat capacity of iron is 4.5 × 10<sup>2</sup> J/(kg·K). How much energy is needed?
Heating 0.50 kg of a substance by 6.0 K takes 12 600 J. Calculate the specific heat capacity.
84 kJ of heat is added to 2.0 kg of water (c = 4.2 × 10<sup>3</sup> J/(kg·K)). By how many K does the temperature rise?
A 2000 W kettle heats 1.5 kg of water from 20 °C to 100 °C (c = 4.18 × 10<sup>3</sup> J/(kg·K)). No energy is lost. How long does it take?
What is the efficiency of an appliance?

answers.a: Useful energy divided by total energy, times 100%
answers.c: Total energy divided by useful energy
answers.d: Wasted energy divided by total energy

questions.question: An appliance converts 1200 J. Of this, 360 J is useful. What is the efficiency?
A 60 W incandescent lamp gives off 3.0 W as light. What is the efficiency?
An appliance has an efficiency of 40%. The useful energy is 200 J. How much energy went in altogether?
An appliance with an efficiency of 25% receives 800 J. How much of it is useful?
A central heating boiler receives 64 MJ of energy from natural gas. The efficiency is 90%. How much energy is used usefully?
A 1.5 kW heater is on for 2.0 hours. That is 3.0 kWh. How many MJ is that? (1 kWh = 3.6 MJ)
In which way is heat transported through a metal pan?
In which way does heat reach the Earth from the Sun?
In which way does warm air spread through a room?
Which material is a good thermal insulator?
Why does double glazing insulate better than single glazing?

answers.a: The gas between the panes conducts heat poorly
answers.c: The glass lets through more light
answers.d: The gas between the panes flows quickly

questions.question: Why are the handles of pans often made of plastic?

answers.d: Plastic radiates a lot of heat

questions.question: What is the unit of specific heat capacity?
What happens to energy that seems to be "lost" through friction?

answers.c: It is converted into gravitational potential energy
answers.d: It is converted into nuclear energy

questions.question: Which substance is used as fuel in a nuclear power station?
For gravitational potential energy: E<sub>z</sub> = m × g × h. Here g = 9.8 N/kg. Calculate the gravitational potential energy of 2.0 kg at a height of 5.0 m.
For kinetic energy: E<sub>k</sub> = ½ × m × v<sup>2</sup>. Calculate the kinetic energy of a 1000 kg car travelling at 10 m/s.
What is the useful energy in an incandescent lamp?
An 8.0 W LED lamp and a 40 W incandescent lamp give the same amount of light. How many times as much energy does the incandescent lamp use in the same time?
